title: Vilsalpsee Tannheim
highlights: Picturesque mountain lake nestled in the heart of a nature reserve
Impressive Beratzwies waterfall cascading at the southern end of the lake
Home to rare alpine wildlife and delicate plant species
Pleasant circular walking trail with dining stops right on the lakeside
kurzbeschreibung: Vilsalpsee lies idyllically nestled within the nature reserve of the Tannheimer Tal, framed by steep alpine peaks.
beschreibung:
Jewel of the Tannheimer Tal Nature Reserve

The Vilsalpsee is considered one of the most scenic mountain lakes in Tirol. Nestled in the protected Vilsalptal at an elevation of 1,165 metres above sea level, its clear waters mirror the steep rock faces of Gaishorn, Rauhhorn, and Schafhafeler, enchanting visitors throughout every season.

Circular Walk and Waterfall

A comfortable lakeside path invites visitors on a leisurely circular walk that is also ideally suited for families with pushchairs. On the southern shore, the Beratzwies-Wasserfall cascades impressively down rugged rock tiers. Traditional lakeside inns serve freshly caught trout and hearty Tyrolean specialities amidst serene mountain tranquility.
